query: SELECT 'item_type' AS object_type, item_type.id, item_type.name AS label FROM item JOIN item_type ON item_type.id = item.item_type_id WHERE item.id = ?1 UNION ALL SELECT 'location', location.id, location.name FROM item_location JOIN location ON location.id = item_location.location_id WHERE item_location.item_id = ?1 UNION ALL SELECT 'character', character.id, character.name FROM item_character JOIN character ON character.id = item_character.character_id WHERE item_character.item_id = ?1 ORDER BY object_type, id
